Smoking Caffeine
Ive frequently eaten and snorted caffeine in the past but have not been able to find much information on smoking it so I decided to test it out. I put a small pinch of caffeine into a meth pipe and held a lighter to it until it vaporized. The vapor was extremely mild, there was not much of it and it didnt hurt at all. After about 30 seconds I felt a very pleasant caffeine come up, it was not jittery at all. In my experience snorting caffeine cause a less jittery effect that eating and smoking was even more pleasant.
My heart did feel a little bit strange for a few minutes so I dont know if I would do this regularly. The high from the caffeine lasted for about 2 hours and then I very rapidly felt myself become extremely tired. Overall it was a pleasant experience and if I could find more information about the health effects of smoking caffeine I might do it regularly.
